key_highlights: Iran war reescalation drives oil surge, reigniting inflation fears and pressuring equities, bonds, and crypto simultaneously
Tech sector bifurcated: software names (Snowflake, Datadog, Palo Alto) sell off pre-earnings while Dell beats on all lines and semiconductors (TSMC, Lam, STM) show strength
Fed Governor Barr signals support for rate hike if inflation persists, complicating the easing narrative
Consumer stress visible: Circle K cites inflation curbing spending, credit card balances reveal K-shaped economy, a dining chain files Chapter 11
Yen surges toward 160 range with intervention risk; India diaspora flows hit $127B, 1.5x estimates
Senegal bond selloff signals emerging-market debt stress; Brazil's Banco Master scandal deepens
AI job displacement narrative intensifies; Uber cuts 3,300 management jobs in global shake-up
Mortgage rates jump double digits on Iran-driven yield spike; CD rates hold near 4.30% APY

sectors.trend: Pre-earnings selloff in cloud/software (SNOW -4%, DD -6%, PANW down) contrasts with hardware/semiconductor strength (DELL beats, TSMC, LRCX, STM). Citi urges buying tumbling tech.
sectors.implications: Rotation from software to hardware/semis; Oracle faces key AI-wave earnings test. Apple-OpenAI trade secret dispute adds governance risk to AI ecosystem.

sectors.trend: Oil surges on renewed US-Iran strikes; US-Venezuela oil deal and Eni's Venezuela production plans add supply-side complexity. Diesel prices emerging as political issue in red states.
sectors.implications: Higher energy costs feed inflation, pressuring consumer discretionary and transportation. Strait of Hormuz risk premium embedded in pricing.

sectors.trend: Circle K flags inflation curbing spending; credit card balances show K-shaped divergence; a Denny's rival files Chapter 11; Costco shuts a key service.
sectors.implications: Consumer bifurcation deepening; lower/middle-income segments under pressure while affluent spend persists. Retail consolidation likely.

sectors.trend: TG Therapeutics eyes breakout; Insmed faces short-term challenges; Tectonic Therapeutic (TECX) strengthened by competitor data; FHLC vs IBBQ ETF comparison active.
sectors.implications: Biotech selective; data-driven catalysts matter. Healthcare ETFs offer diversification vs. tech volatility.

sectors.trend: Capital One faces AML scrutiny; Senegal bond selloff; Brazil Banco Master scandal; India diaspora flows surge to $127B; Apax €1B debt for Gerresheimer.
sectors.implications: EM debt risk elevated; India is relative safe haven. US financials face regulatory overhang.

sectors.trend: L3Harris (LHX) declines despite strong results; Rocket Lab collapsed 57% from highs; Iran war drives defense spending narrative.
sectors.implications: Defense names decoupling from earnings; geopolitical premium may persist but valuations stretched in some names.

key_themes: Iran war escalation as dominant macro risk driver across all asset classes
Inflation reacceleration risk from oil, pressuring Fed easing timeline
Tech sector rotation: software under pressure, semiconductors and hardware resilient
K-shaped consumer economy with widening income-based spending divergence
AI disruption accelerating in labor markets (Uber cuts, AI job displacement)
EM debt stress (Senegal, Brazil) vs. India capital inflow strength
Yen intervention risk at 160 level; currency volatility elevated
Crypto and precious metals whipsawing on geopolitical headlines
EU data center investment debate signals long-term AI infrastructure buildout
Regulatory/governance risks: Apple-OpenAI dispute, Capital One AML, proxy betting scrutiny

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy long positions or oil call options; maintain 10-15% allocation to energy/defense; monitor Strait of Hormuz developments daily
Reduce duration in fixed income; favor short-duration or TIPS; avoid over-leveraged consumer names; watch Barr's rate hike signal as policy inflection

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tech Earnings Miss / Software Selloff Continuation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid pre-earnings positions in SNOW, DD, PANW, ORCL until results; Citi's contrarian buy signal suggests potential 2-3 week dip-buying window post-earnings
Avoid Senegal and Brazil sovereign exposure; favor India (INR) and select EM with strong FDI; monitor CDS spreads weekly
Hedge USD/JPY exposure; avoid leveraged yen trades near 160; monitor BOJ intervention signals
Underweight lower-tier consumer discretionary; favor premium/affluent-facing brands; monitor credit card delinquency data

opportunities.recommendation: Buy the software dip post-earnings; Citi signals accumulation zone
opportunities.rationale: SNOW, DD, PANW selling on pre-earnings fear not fundamentals; Citi explicitly recommends buying tumbling tech. Dell's beat validates enterprise IT spending cycle.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight semiconductor equipment and foundry names
opportunities.rationale: TSMC, Lam Research, STMicro benefit from AI capex cycle and EU data center buildout; less exposed to software margin compression
Iran war premium supports oil and defense; LHX strong results despite stock decline suggests undervaluation; Eni/Venezuela adds supply narrative
$127B diaspora flows (1.5x estimate) signal structural capital inflow; relative safe haven vs. Senegal/Brazil stress

opportunities.recommendation: Selective biotech: TG Therapeutics breakout play
opportunities.rationale: IBD Stock of the Day; topping early buy point suggests momentum; competitor data strengthens pipeline

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce equity duration; shift to short-duration bonds or TIPS
defensive_moves.rationale: Barr's rate hike signal + oil-driven inflation risk make long-duration bonds vulnerable; TIPS hedge real inflation

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Rocket Lab and speculative space/aerospace names
defensive_moves.rationale: 57% collapse from highs; analyst explicitly advises not buying yet; high beta amplifies geopolitical risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight lower-tier consumer discretionary and restaurant stocks
defensive_moves.rationale: K-shaped economy, Circle K spending warnings, Chapter 11 filings signal structural pressure on mass-market consumer

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge crypto exposure; avoid new BTC/ETH positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Crypto tumbling on Iran war; risk-off environment; no fundamental catalyst to offset geopolitical premium

defensive_moves.recommendation: Lock in CD/HYSA rates near 4.1-4.3% APY before potential Fed pivot
defensive_moves.rationale: Rates elevated but Fed may hold or hike; locking in 4.3% APY (Marcus) or 4.1% HYSA preserves yield if rates stabilize

market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely volatile and range-bound. Iran war headlines will drive daily oil swings and risk-off spikes. Tech earnings season (Oracle, Palo Alto) will determine whether software selloff is a buying opportunity or trend continuation. Yen intervention risk at 160 adds FX noise. Expect S&P 500 to consolidate after three-day skid with oil as the swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (semis, data centers, EU buildout) remains structurally supportive for tech hardware. K-shaped consumer divergence will persist, favoring premium and affluent-facing businesses. Fed path hinges on oil-driven inflation; if Iran de-escalates, easing resumes by Q1 2027. EM bifurcation continues: India strong, Africa/Latin America fragile. Defense spending elevated structurally.
